description: Regula于1956年推出的旁轴相机。配备Steinheil Munchen Cassar 45mm f/2.8。快门速度Prontor-SVS - Bulb, 1s, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/15, 1/30, 1/60, 1/125 and 1/300th.。

specs.自拍: Yes, around 10 seconds, use V mode on the lens
specs.闪光灯: PC socket on the body, flash synchronization at all speeds, X and M modes
specs.光圈: Supports lenses from f/2 to f/22 in 1 stop increments
specs.英文简介: The King Regula III series were a range of 35mm viewfinder and rangefinder cameras made by King between 1956-1959.
